newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary o/n rates close lower, at 21 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary o/n rates close lower, at 21 percent.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interbank interest rates fell on Wednesday in a liquid market before the end of the banks' reserve period, dealers said.
Overnight rates opened at 21.5 percent but eased to 21 percent by the close, compared with Tuesday's end of 21.75 percent.
"We are at the end of the period, and everybody has money," said Hypo-Bank Hungaria's Zoltan Kalman.
The overnigt rates were seen continuing to drop until the end of the reserve period on Friday.
